## Today's learning {#iv3-objective .vector-lesson .component-lesson .position-lesson}

### Learning objective

Use position vectors to describe locations and calculate vectors between points.

### Success criterion

I can find a displacement or endpoint in 2D and 3D and explain the direction using a diagram.

::: takeaway
The starting point and finishing point determine the displacement.
:::

::: notes
Make the relationship between point coordinates and vector components explicit. A point is a location; a vector describes magnitude and direction. Once an origin is chosen, its position vector joins that origin to the point.
:::
